content: Gemini CLI headless: triggered by -p/--prompt or a non-TTY environment. --output-format json returns a single JSON object with response plus usage stats; --non-interactive suppresses prompts. Auth via GOOGLE_API_KEY or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS env vars, no login flow. Note: Gemini CLI returns ONE JSON object at completion rather than a JSONL event stream (unlike claude -p --output-format stream-json and codex exec --json), so an adapter abstraction must tolerate 'no incremental events' backends. Official Node SDK for the raw API is @google/genai (2.17.1).
